title: Allow right-click copy-to-clipboard of selected date in calendar popup
line: Right-clicking a day in the Digital Clock's calendar now offers to copy that date to the clipboard.
explanation: The Digital Clock's Copy to Clipboard menu (on the panel clock) only builds strings from the current date and time, and the calendar's day cells had no right-click handling at all, so another day could not be copied. The change adds a context menu request to the shared calendar's day cells (right-click or long press), which the month view forwards after selecting that day; the Digital Clock's calendar shows a small menu that copies the day in short, long and ISO format.

commits.message:
applets/digitalclock: allow copying any date from the calendar

The Copy to Clipboard menu only offered today's date, so there was no way
to copy another day shown in the calendar. Right-clicking or long-pressing
a day now selects it and opens a menu to copy it in a few date formats.

BUG: 330531

media.caption: Right-clicking 12 November in the calendar: nothing happens
Right-clicking 17 November opens a menu to copy that date
